trigger: Age under 18
rationale: Pediatric growth and nutrient needs require a pediatric pathway.

trigger: Current/past eating disorder, severe restriction, purging or rapid unexplained weight change
Recent hospitalization, major surgery, active infection, cancer treatment or medically unstable state
BP above 180/120 mmHg with chest pain, dyspnea, weakness, numbness, vision or speech change
Repeated BP above 180/120 mmHg without emergency symptoms
rationale: Prompt clinician contact; no routine plan activation.

trigger: Type 1 diabetes
Insulin, sulfonylurea or recurrent hypoglycemia
rationale: Do not change carbohydrate timing/amount without medication plan.

trigger: Vomiting, dehydration, confusion, ketones or suspected hyperglycemic crisis
Pregnancy or planning pregnancy
Missing current eGFR, potassium or kidney diagnosis/stage
rationale: Renal food choices cannot be safely selected.

trigger: eGFR below 30, dialysis, transplant, AKI, unstable labs or major edema
Clinically abnormal potassium or phosphorus
rationale: Diet changes require lab-specific medical review.

trigger: Fluid restriction, kidney failure or heart failure
rationale: Do not automatically advise increased fluids.

trigger: Ascites, encephalopathy/confusion, vomiting blood or black stool
Cirrhosis/decompensation or marked sarcopenia
rationale: Energy, protein, sodium and meal timing require specialist care.

trigger: Any pregnancy
rationale: Obstetric approval required before plan display.

trigger: Severe vomiting, bleeding, severe headache/vision symptoms, marked swelling, high BP or reduced fetal movement
rationale: Immediate obstetric triage according to local protocol.

trigger: Postpartum under 6 weeks
Heavy bleeding, fever, wound concerns, severe headache, chest pain, dyspnea or severe mood symptoms
Severe/symptomatic anemia, pregnancy, active bleeding or unclear cause
GI bleeding, dysphagia, persistent vomiting, anemia or unexplained weight loss
CKD mineral-bone disorder, hypercalcemia or recurrent kidney stones
Three or more active medical conditions or conflicting restrictions
Severe food allergy or anaphylaxis history
rationale: Verified allergen data and cross-contact controls required.
